alerts.title: Research update: BB rebounds from weak open
alerts.summary: BlackBerry's September 24 earnings and raised outlook remain verified. In regular trading on September 28, BB was $8.13 at 14:26:36 UTC, down 0.97%, after opening at $7.89 and rebounding from a $7.87 low to an $8.23 high on 5,509,314 shares. The recovery materially improves the structure versus the roughly 6% pre-market gap down, but the stock remains below the prior close and no exact qualifying option contract could be validated.
reasons: At 14:26:36 UTC, BB traded at $8.13, down 0.97%, after opening at $7.89 and rebounding from a $7.87 low.
Intraday volume was 5,509,314 shares and the high reached $8.23, showing a meaningful reclaim from the weak opening print.
Q2 FY2027 revenue increased 26% year over year to $163.3 million.
Adjusted EBITDA increased 81% year over year and operating cash flow was $29.3 million.
QNX secured its largest design win to date and management raised full-year revenue and adjusted EBITDA outlook.

alerts.title: Research update: FTHM fails post-catalyst continuation
alerts.summary: Fathom's September 24 proposed digital-asset restructuring remains a verified but preliminary catalyst. In regular trading on September 28, FTHM was $0.522 at 13:34:15 UTC, down 10.46% from the prior close, after opening at $0.5225 and trading between $0.5031 and $0.5903 on 1,504,131 shares. The volume did not produce constructive continuation, so the setup remains research-only and is not eligible for a paper entry.
reasons: The September 24 issuer announcement and Form 8-K confirm that the parties agreed to explore an alternative transaction structure.
The proposed contributed assets are described as worth at least $130 million, subject to validation, definitive agreements and approvals.
At 13:34:15 UTC on September 28, FTHM traded at $0.522, down 10.46%, with a $0.5031-$0.5903 range and 1,504,131 shares traded.
The stock opened near $0.5225 and failed to sustain its pre-market indication, so price structure did not confirm the catalyst.
The transaction remains non-definitive, uses newly issued shares, and is expected to leave NXH in control.
